subject: Immediate coverage plan for Senior Data Engineer (RoHAN) — action items
messages:
From: rohan_mehta@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 05 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Notice: Resignation (last day Nov 14)

Hi Kim / Laura / Monica,

I wanted to let you know that I am resigning from Redwood; my last day will be Friday, Nov 14. This was a difficult decision — I appreciate the opportunities here and the team.

I am starting a short handoff pack (attached) that lists active tickets, on-call rotations, credentials, and two short runbooks for the Avery integration and the nightly embeddings pipeline. I can be available for knowledge transfer sessions Nov 6–12 (blockable) and will prioritize the PRs that are blocking the holiday ingest job.

Attachments: resignation_letter_rohan_mehta.pdf; rohan_project_inventory.xlsx

Please let me know what else you need from me to make the transition smooth.

Thanks,
Rohan Mehta
Senior Data Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: rohan_mehta@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 05 Nov 2025 09:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Notice: Resignation (last day Nov 14)

Rohan — thank you for the heads up and for the attachments. I appreciate the advance notice. Immediate asks: 

- Can you produce a one-page priority list by EOD today that calls out (1) critical on-call runbooks, (2) two highest-risk PRs, and (3) any active coordination with third parties (Avery).
- Schedule two 60-min knowledge-transfer sessions (recordable) next week: one focused on Avery SRE handoff and one on the nightly embeddings pipeline.
- Confirm whether there are any outstanding Prod access keys that need rotation; if so, mark them in the inventory spreadsheet.

I am setting up a triage meeting with Laura and Markus at 11:30 today to confirm coverage and whether we need to open a short-term contractor request. Monica — can you confirm the exit checklist and DocuSign timeline? I will also loop in CS for any customer-impacting items if Avery has open tickets.

Attachments: requested-priority-template.md (draft)

Subject: Re: Notice: Resignation (last day Nov 14) — HR steps

Thanks for the ping. Monica from HR here — I will own the formal exit steps. Quick notes and links: 

- Please complete the DocuSign exit packet by EOD Nov 7 (link attached as a stub: docusign_exit_packet_link.txt).
- Final payroll/benefits timeline: final paycheck processed 11/21 (regular pay cadence) unless payroll needs an earlier date; please confirm any outstanding expenses by Nov 12.
- We will schedule an exit interview (optional) and a short compliance checklist (KMS/HSM key handoff, laptop return, access revocation).

Action items for Rohan: please populate the inventory spreadsheet with any third-party account owners and credentials that require rotation. HR case: HR-2025-1105-77.

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com

Cc: markus_klein@redwood.com, jessica@averysys.com
Date: Thu, 06 Nov 2025 16:23:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Immediate coverage plan for Senior Data Engineer (RoHAN) — action items

Following up from the triage: we have three concrete steps and an escalation. Summary: 

1) Coverage: Marcus (Data Infra) will take first responder for the embeddings pipeline for two weeks; Kimberly will own prioritization and the release window. We will request a 4-week contractor for PR backlog if recruiting cannot accelerate.

2) Knowledge capture: Rohan, please record the Avery integration handoff on Monday 11/10 and drop the recording and the runbook into the shared doc: https://docs.redwood.internal/knowledge/rohan-oncall-runbook. We need clear runbook steps for rotating the SRE key used by the Avery webhook.

3) Access & security: Monica — please coordinate KMS key rotation and ensure contracts@averysys.com is notified that the service account will be rotated on 11/15. Jessica (Avery) — flagging an outstanding change request (CR-452) that Rohan was owning; please confirm whether you need a post-11/14 handoff.

Escalation: Avery has a pending production cutover next week that depends on a tweak Rohan was implementing. If Avery cannot pause the cutover, we need to approve an emergency contractor for Nov 10–21. Kimberly — please approve the contractor request if we cannot reassign quickly.
